label: As soon as possible
subgoals: Start every source operation in step 1
Start each other operation at the latest predecessor start plus latency
Visit the operations in topological order

label: The minimum schedule length
subgoals: Find the finishing step of every operation in the ASAP schedule
Take the largest finishing step as the minimum length
Read it as a lower bound for any resource-limited schedule

label: As late as possible
subgoals: Start every sink at L minus its latency plus 1
Start each other operation at its earliest consumer's start minus its own latency
Pair the ASAP and ALAP starts into a time frame
